jobs.title: Account Executive  - DACH
jobs.description:
About the Role

We're building the sales engine for Tellent HR in the DACH market, and we're looking for an Account Executive to help us do it. Think of it as joining a startup inside a scale-up.

First and foremost, this is a hands-on selling role. You'll own the full sales cycle for Tellent HR (Manage and/or Grow), split roughly 80/20 between new business and expansion into our existing customer base. Inbound isn't going to be your main pipeline driver, so expect to spend around 50% of your time prospecting, against ambitious daily and weekly activity targets. Alongside that, you'll help us work out how we win in DACH: testing motions fast and doubling down on what drives revenue.

You'll work with a dedicated Product Marketing Manager and Customer Success Manager in the Tellent HR squad. CS capacity is limited, though, so you'll run deals independently, including demos and follow-through.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • First 3 months: Learn Tellent HR, our ideal customers and the competitive landscape in DACH. Build your first pipeline through outbound, establish a consistent daily activity rhythm, and close your first deals.

  • Within 6 months: Consistently hit your activity, pipeline and revenue targets, understand which sales motions work best in the DACH market, and feed insights back to Product Marketing and Product.

  • After 1 year: Be the go-to expert on selling Tellent HR in DACH, with a repeatable, data-backed playbook that others can pick up.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the full sales cycle, independently: Run 1–3 month, multi-stakeholder deals involving HR leaders, founders/CEOs and Finance, from first touch through to close and follow-through.

  • Hunt for new pipeline (around 50% of your time): Prospect by phone, email and LinkedIn, consistently hit your daily and weekly activity targets, and maintain 3–4x pipeline coverage. Partner, CS and marketing leads are a bonus, not the plan.

  • Drive expansion: Prospect into existing Tellent customers to cross-sell and upsell, e.g. Recruitee customers adding Tellent HR, or Manage customers adding Grow.

  • Sell on value: Run consultative discovery and tailored demos, position on business outcomes, and handle objections, including against key competitors (with support from PMM).

  • Manage deals with discipline: Use mutual action plans, keep HubSpot accurate (including SPICED), forecast reliably and disqualify early.

  • Test and build, alongside selling: Experiment with sales motions, sequences and verticals, help build the playbook with our PMM, and bring customer and competitive insights from the DACH market back to Product and Marketing.

What You Bring

  • Early-stage DNA: You've sold in a startup or early scale-up and built pipeline and processes where none existed. You know what it means to be an early sales hire.

  • Proven hunter: A track record of self-generating pipeline through outbound and consistently hitting ambitious activity targets. You genuinely enjoy picking up the phone and creating opportunities from scratch.

  • B2B SaaS sales experience: You've closed new business (ideally expansion too) as a fully autonomous AE in a startup or early scale-up, running 1–5 month, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. HR tech experience is a plus, not essential.

  • Self-sufficient and resilient: You don't wait for leads, support teams or perfect processes. You bounce back from rejection and stay disciplined through the ups and downs of building something new.

  • Consultative and data-driven: Strong discovery, demo and negotiation skills. You anchor on value before price and know your numbers (pipeline, conversion, win rate and cycle time).

  • Languages: Fluent English and native or fluent German are required. You'll be responsible for engaging customers and building relationships across the DACH market.

This role probably isn't for you if you want a structured environment with large support teams and steady inbound, or you're more excited by GTM strategy than by picking up the phone every day.

How We Measure Success

  • Closed-won revenue against target (primary KPI)

  • Daily and weekly outbound activity targets (key leading indicator, especially early on)

  • Self-generated pipeline and coverage

  • Win rate, deal velocity and forecast accuracy

  • Contributions to the playbook

What We Offer

  • Compensation: €55000–€70000 gross annual base salary, plus commission.

  • Ownership and impact: Real autonomy to shape the sales motion, playbook and market strategy for a growing product line.

  • Hybrid working: Work from our canal-side Amsterdam office 2–3 days per week.

  • International environment: Join a diverse and international team working across multiple markets.

  • Learning & Development: €1,500 annual learning budget and 2 dedicated learning days.

  • Pension & Wellness: Pension plan and wellness perks.

  • Time Off: 28 paid holiday days, plus 2 additional days in 2026.

  • Work from Anywhere: Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year.

  • Commuting: Commuting and travel reimbursement.

  • Home Office: €200 home office budget and a work-from-home allowance.

  • Equipment: Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed.

About Tellent

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).

With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we're just getting started.

AI in Our Recruitment Process

We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement, check our Privacy Policy, or chat with us at

If you require accommodations or support during the recruitment process, please let us know — we're happy to help.

jobs.title: Lead Java Software Engineer (v/m/x)
jobs.location: Capelle aan den IJssel, Zuid-Holland, Nederland
jobs.description:
Bouw mee aan de digitale toekomst van de openbare ruimte

Bij Progresity ontwikkelen we software die gemeenten helpt om de openbare ruimte slimmer, veiliger en duurzamer te beheren. Onze applicatie BinnenBeter verbindt inwoners en gemeenten: via de BuitenBeter app kunnen inwoners eenvoudig meldingen doen van problemen in de openbare ruimte, van kapotte straatverlichting tot zwerfafval of een losliggende stoeptegel. Gemeenten ontvangen deze meldingen in BinnenBeter en kunnen ze efficiënt opvolgen, zodat elke melding leidt tot een zichtbare verbetering in de leefomgeving. Zo zorgen we samen voor schonere, veiligere en beter onderhouden steden voor miljoenen inwoners in Nederland.

We staan aan de vooravond van een belangrijke volgende stap. Niet alleen ontwikkelen we onze software verder, ook professionaliseren we de manier waarop we software bouwen. We willen groeien naar een moderne engineeringorganisatie waarin eigenaarschap, kwaliteit, automatisering en continu verbeteren centraal staan.

Daarom zoeken we een Lead Software Engineer (Java) die niet alleen technisch sterk is, maar ook energie krijgt van het verder brengen van een engineeringteam. Iemand die verder kijkt dan de code van vandaag, een duidelijke technische visie kan ontwikkelen en anderen weet mee te nemen in verandering. Die begrijpt dat goede software niet alleen draait om technologie, maar ook om samenwerking, vakmanschap en het maken van de juiste keuzes.

Jouw rol

Als Lead Software Engineer (Java) combineer je hands-on software engineering met technisch leiderschap. Je werkt binnen een multidisciplinair productteam aan de verdere ontwikkeling van BinnenBeter en neemt het voortouw in de technische richting en professionalisering van Engineering.

Je bent eigenaar van de technische visie en architectuur van het product. Je bepaalt samen met je collega's hoe we onze software toekomstbestendig houden en vertaalt technische ambities naar concrete verbeteringen. Daarbij kijk je verder dan nieuwe functionaliteiten: ook onderhoudbaarheid, schaalbaarheid, security, betrouwbaarheid en technische schuld krijgen structureel aandacht.

Tegelijkertijd ben je een belangrijke kartrekker in het verbeteren van onze manier van werken. Hoe kunnen we sneller en betrouwbaarder releasen? Hoe maken we geautomatiseerd testen en CI/CD vanzelfsprekend? Hoe zorgen we dat engineers verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor hun software, ook nadat deze in productie staat?

Je hoeft deze uitdagingen niet alleen op te lossen. Je coacht Software Engineers, stimuleert eigenaarschap en zorgt dat technische kennis en verantwoordelijkheden niet bij één persoon blijven liggen.

Je gaat onder andere aan de slag met:

  • Het ontwikkelen, uitdragen en bewaken van de technische visie en softwarearchitectuur van BinnenBeter.

  • Het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van robuuste, onderhoudbare en schaalbare software met Java en Spring Boot.

  • Het richting geven aan belangrijke technische keuzes en het ontwikkelen en borgen van engineeringstandaarden en architectuurprincipes.

  • Het vertalen van relevante wet- en regelgeving en beveiligingseisen naar concrete technische richtlijnen.

  • Het verbeteren van onze engineeringpraktijken, waaronder CI/CD, testautomatisering, observability en DevOps.

  • Het inzichtelijk maken en structureel aanpakken van technische schuld, kwetsbaarheden en andere technische risico's.

  • Het ontwikkelen en realiseren van een technische verbeteragenda, samen met het engineeringteam.

  • Het coachen van Software Engineers en stimuleren van zelfstandigheid, kennisdeling en technisch eigenaarschap.

  • Het versterken van de samenwerking tussen Engineering, Product, UX, Quality en Cloud/Platform.

  • Het onderzoeken van nieuwe technologieën en werkwijzen, waaronder AI, die onze software of manier van ontwikkelen daadwerkelijk beter maken.


Wat neem je mee?

We zoeken een ervaren Software Engineer die inhoudelijk sterk is, maar ook begrijpt dat technisch leiderschap meer vraagt dan het maken van goede technische keuzes.

 

Je kunt complexe vraagstukken analyseren en een duidelijke richting bepalen. Tegelijkertijd weet je anderen daarin mee te nemen, sta je open voor andere perspectieven en haal je voldoening uit het ontwikkelen van collega's.

 

Wat we belangrijk vinden:

  • Ruime ervaring met Java en Spring Boot en een sterke achtergrond in professionele software engineering.

  • Ervaring met softwarearchitectuur, REST API's en het ontwerpen van onderhoudbare en schaalbare applicaties.

  • Je kunt complexe technische vraagstukken doorgronden, alternatieven afwegen en onderbouwde technische keuzes maken.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het ontwikkelen of verbeteren van technische standaarden, architectuurprincipes en engineeringpraktijken.

  • Je hebt kennis van moderne softwareontwikkeling, waaronder CI/CD, geautomatiseerd testen, security en observability.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het begeleiden of coachen van andere Software Engineers en vindt het leuk om collega's technisch verder te helpen.

  • Je communiceert helder, kunt technische onderwerpen begrijpelijk uitleggen en weet verschillende disciplines met elkaar te verbinden.

  • Je neemt initiatief, durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en weet ideeën om te zetten in concrete verbeteringen.

  • Je bent pragmatisch en kunt een goede balans vinden tussen technische kwaliteit, ontwikkelsnelheid en klantwaarde.

  • Je bent beschikbaar voor 32, 36 of 40 uur per week.

 

Mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste:

  • Ervaring met Angular en TypeScript.

  • Ervaring met WildFly, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes of vergelijkbare technologieën.

  • Ervaring met het begeleiden van technische veranderingen of het professionaliseren van een engineeringteam.

  • Ervaring met cloud-native architecturen, DevOps en het beheren van software in productie.

 

Je hoeft niet eerder de functietitel Lead Software Engineer te hebben gehad. Misschien ben je nu Senior Software Engineer of Software Architect en merk je dat je steeds vaker technische richting geeft, collega's begeleidt en verbeteringen initieert. Als je klaar bent om daarin een volgende stap te zetten, gaan we graag met je in gesprek.

 

Dan bieden wij jou

  • Een salaris tussen €4.500,- en €6.690,- bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van jouw ervaring.

  • Een rol waarin je daadwerkelijk invloed hebt op de technische richting van onze software en de ontwikkeling van Engineering.

  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, technische verbeteringen en het toepassen van nieuwe technologieën.

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden en een modern kantoor in Capelle aan den IJssel.

  • Werken in een team waar jouw ideeën daadwerkelijk worden gehoord.

  • 8% vakantiegeld.

  • 25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen bij te kopen.

  • Laptop van de zaak.

  • Goede pensioenregeling en collectieve bonus.

  • Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.

  • Een rol waarin jouw werk iedere dag maatschappelijke impact heeft.

 

Over Progresity

Progresity is onderdeel van de Conxillium Group. Samen ontwikkelen we slimme software voor gemeenten. Onze producten ondersteunen gemeenten bij het beheren van de openbare ruimte: van bomen en groenvoorzieningen tot wegen, verlichting en meldingen van inwoners.

We bevinden ons in een interessante fase. We groeien van een traditionele softwareorganisatie naar productgerichte teams waarin eigenaarschap, samenwerking en continu verbeteren centraal staan. Dat betekent dat developers bij ons niet alleen meedenken over hoe we software bouwen, maar ook over waarom we iets bouwen en welke waarde dat oplevert voor onze gebruikers.

Je komt terecht in een hecht team waarin vakmanschap, nieuwsgierigheid en elkaar helpen belangrijker zijn dan hiërarchie. We geloven dat de beste ideeën ontstaan wanneer mensen verantwoordelijkheid krijgen en samen blijven leren.

Lees meer over onze organisatie op: www.progresity.com.

Sollicitatieproces

Ons sollicitatieproces bestaat meestal uit drie gesprekken. We vinden het belangrijk dat we elkaar goed leren kennen. Naast jouw technische kennis zijn we vooral benieuwd hoe jij samenwerkt, hoe je naar softwareontwikkeling kijkt en hoe jij jezelf én een team verder helpt groeien.

Enthousiast?

Wil jij bijdragen aan slimmere, veiligere en duurzamere software voor gemeenten én meebouwen aan de volgende stap van onze engineeringorganisatie? Reageer dan via de sollicitatiebutton of neem contact op met onze recruiter Steven Kruis via 06 57 43 92 61 of

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Manager – Legal AI Scaleup
jobs.description:
Du entscheidest, was wir bauen und über 450 Kanzleien täglich nutzen.

Als Product Manager:in bist du die zentrale Stimme dafür, wohin sich unser KI-Associate entwickelt. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründungsteam, sprichst täglich mit Kanzleien und baust Prototypen selbst, statt sie nur zu beschreiben. Du prägst entscheidend, wie sich Silvernova strategisch und produktseitig weiterentwickelt.

Über uns: Silvernova entwickelt den ersten digitalen Mitarbeiter für Anwaltskanzleien – die führende Lösung für komplexe Mandate. VC-finanziert und Investoren von Top-Kanzleien an Bord. Über 450 Anwaltskanzleien nutzen den KI-Associate täglich – damit sind wir eines der am schnellsten wachsenden LegalTech-Scaleups Deutschlands: Du baust daran von Anfang an mit.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Produktstrategie & Roadmap – Du entwickelst die Produktvision für die nächsten Jahre, priorisierst die Roadmap und arbeitest Features bis zur Umsetzungsreife aus.

  • Prototyping – Du baust ausgereifte Prototypen und neue Agenten-Fähigkeiten selbst mit AI-Tools und validierst sie mit Kunden, bevor Entwicklungszeit fließt.

  • Kundennähe – Du stehst in engem Kontakt mit unseren Kanzleien, verstehst ihre Arbeitsabläufe im Detail, erkennst, wo der Schuh drückt, und bringst das zurück ins Produkt.

  • Sparring mit Engineering – Du bist Ansprechperson für unsere Entwickler:innen während der Umsetzung: Anforderungen schärfen, Trade-offs entscheiden, Qualität abnehmen.

  • Release-Kommunikation – Wir releasen jede Woche. Du sorgst dafür, dass Customer Success, Sales und unsere Kunden wissen, was neu ist – über Release Notes, unsere Product-Academy und Webinare.

Was du mitbringst

  • Einer von zwei Wegen – Entweder mehrere Jahre Produktmanagement in einem SaaS-Scaleup oder Erfahrung als Anwält:in mit nachweisbarer Produkt- und KI-Affinität. Wer beide Welten kennt, ist unser Idealfall – Voraussetzung ist es nicht.

  • AI-native – Du hast selbst schon Anwendungen gebaut (z.B. Vibecoding) und kannst sie uns zeigen. Du verstehst, was agentische Systeme heute können – und was (noch) nicht.

  • Gespür für Design & UI – Du hast ein genaues Auge für Details und weißt, wann ein Feature wirklich fertig ist und wann nicht.

  • Unternehmerisches Denken – Du hast eine eigene, begründete Meinung dazu, wohin sich Legal AI entwickelt, und denkst in Markt und Wirkung, nicht nur in Features.

  • Kommunikationsstärke – Du trittst gegenüber Kanzleien souverän auf, formulierst gegenüber Engineering präzise und schreibst verständlich. Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, Englisch mindestens C1.

Wenn du nicht alles erfüllst: Bewirb dich trotzdem. Wir suchen Potenzial, nicht Perfektion.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Ownership & Gestaltungsspielraum – Du bist die zentrale Stimme dafür, wohin sich Silvernova strategisch und produktseitig entwickelt – mit direktem Draht zum Gründungsteam und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

  • Mitarbeiterbeteiligung – Über unser Beteiligungsprogramm profitierst du direkt vom Unternehmenswert. Wächst Silvernova, wächst dein Anteil mit.

  • Entwicklung & Perspektive – Du baust die Produktfunktion bei uns mit auf, mit der Perspektive, sie zu leiten und ein eigenes Team aufzubauen.

  • Teamkultur – Offenes, wertschätzendes Miteinander in einem rund 20-köpfigen Team, kurze Wege zum Gründungsteam und regelmäßige Team-Events.

  • Office-First mit Flexibilität – Mindestens drei Tage pro Woche arbeiten wir gemeinsam in unserem Münchner Büro, weil wir an echten Austausch glauben. Die übrige Zeit gestaltest du flexibel.

  • Wellpass inklusive – Zugang zu hunderten Sport-, Fitness- und Wellnessangeboten.

So geht es weiter

Uns interessieren deine konkreten Erfahrungen, Entscheidungen und Lernprozesse mehr als eine perfekte Vita. Bei den Bewerbungsfragen reichen Stichpunkte – und zeig uns gern etwas, das du selbst gebaut hast.

Wir freuen uns darauf, gemeinsam mit dir herauszufinden, wie du bei Silvernova Impact schaffen kannst – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Religion, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität.

jobs.title: Designer (Freelance, m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Your mission

About L1VE

L1VE is a growing media and technology company with offices in Berlin and New York. With immersive 14K/3D/360° streaming technology and innovative live formats, we are changing the way people experience sports, music and entertainment.

Your Role

As Designer, you shape how L1VE looks and how people experience it, from the first ad to the ticket purchase on our website. Our website is at the heart of the role: you design user journeys and pages that convert. You also create our event banners, flyers, ads and social assets. You take full ownership of design, build it up from the start and keep it lean, flexible and fast.
You work closely with our Social Media Manager, our Content & Experience team and Product & Tech, and report to the Head of Marketing & Sales.

  • Full-time (5 days/week), project-based, 12 months
  • Work remotely within Europe or Asia, or on-site in Berlin

What You'll Do

  • Design and continuously improve our website, from first visit to ticket purchase, and make it instantly clear what L1VE is: a real live broadcast you experience with a VR headset
  • Map and optimize user journeys; create wireframes, prototypes and final designs in Figma
  • Design for conversion: identify drop-offs, develop hypotheses and test page and flow variants based on analytics data
  • Hand over developer-ready, responsive designs and build a clear design system with reusable components
  • Design landing pages, key visuals and asset packages for our live events (banners, flyers, posters, on-site materials) and for email campaigns
  • Create paid ads for social and display (static and simple motion) in all required formats, with variations for A/B testing
  • Follow the design guidelines of our license partners precisely, keep our brand consistent, and brief external freelancers or agencies when more capacity is needed
  • Use AI tools for ideation, image creation, variations and resizing; L1VE provides the AI tools you need

Your profile

Must-have

  • 3–5 years of experience as a designer with a focus on web/UX and marketing design, in-house or at an agency
  • A portfolio with website and UX work with measurable conversion results, plus campaign and ad design
  • Proven experience working precisely within strict brand and partner guidelines, e.g. from leagues, federations or licensors
  • Strong UX skills and conversion experience: user journeys, wireframing, prototyping, landing pages, checkout or sign-up flows, A/B tests and working with analytics data
  • Excellent command of Figma (components, design systems, developer handoff) and Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong sense of typography, layout and visual hierarchy, and a bold, creative eye
  • Fluent written and spoken English (C1 or higher), German is a plus

Nice-to-have

  • Motion skills (After Effects or similar)
  • Experience designing for paid social (Meta, TikTok), including formats and safe zones
  • Experience preparing print production files
  • Practical experience with AI design and image tools
  • Interest in sports, entertainment and immersive technology

Why us?

  • You shape how L1VE looks and how users experience it, from the ground up, with real ownership.
  • You see the direct impact of your work on conversion and ticket sales.
  • You get access to the AI tools you need.
  • You get plenty of creative freedom, short decision paths and flexible hours.

Interested?

Send us your CV, a link to your portfolio, your day rate, and a few sentences on why you're a great fit for L1VE and the Designer role.

L1VE is committed to equal opportunities. We welcome applications regardless of origin, gender, age, religion, disability or sexual identity.

Contact person

jobs.title: Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir bauen humanoide Systeme: Full Stack, von Hardware und Elektronik über Software bis zur Fertigung, alles in-house in Berlin.

Bei Cell Labs verschieben wir die Grenze dessen, was Robotik leisten kann. Unser Ziel ist klar: Systeme bauen, die Menschen stärken statt sie zu ersetzen. Unsere Technologie ist bereits bei führenden Industriekunden und Partnern im Einsatz. Jetzt steht unser eigenes Produkt kurz vor dem Launch.

Die leise Phase ist vorbei. Wir suchen Menschen, die früh dabei sein wollen, Verantwortung übernehmen und das bauen, worüber andere nur reden.

Ort: Berlin · Start: Ab sofort · Arbeitsmodell: Vor Ort · Anstellung: Vollzeit

Deine Aufgaben

  • Marketingstrategie & Umsetzung: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Gründer:in und dem restlichen Kreativteam die Markenstrategie von Cell Labs weiter und gestaltest u. a. den bevorstehenden Produktlaunch aktiv mit, von Messaging über Kampagnen bis zu Events.

  • Digital Marketing & Performance: Du entwickelst unsere digitale Sichtbarkeit weiter, optimierst Website, SEO und SEA und setzt zielgerichtete Kampagnen auf. Dabei testest du neue Ansätze und verbesserst kontinuierlich ihre Wirkung.

  • Content & Kommunikation: Du übersetzt komplexe Robotik-Technologien in verständliche und überzeugende Inhalte für unsere Website, Social Media, Newsletter und weitere Kanäle. Dafür arbeitest du eng mit unseren Gründern, dem Brand- und Designteam sowie den Engineers zusammen.

  • Go-to-Market: Du planst und steuerst Marketingkampagnen entlang des gesamten Funnels, entwickelst Maßnahmen zur B2B-Leadgenerierung und machst Cell Labs bei relevanten Industrieunternehmen und Partnern sichtbar.

  • Events & Kooperationen: Du planst und begleitest relevante Messen, Konferenzen und Partneraktivitäten – von der Vorbereitung der Marketingmaterialien über die Kommunikation bis zur Nachbereitung.

  • Marketing Operations & Analytics: Du definierst, misst und berichtest die Kennzahlen, die zählen: Pipeline-Beitrag, Conversion, Cost per Lead und Funnel-Entwicklung. Daraus leitest du Entscheidungen ab, statt nur Reports zu verwalten.

  • Sales Enablement: In enger Abstimmung mit unseren Gründern unterstützt du Vertrieb und Business Development mit Pitch-Materialien, Use Cases, Case Studies und Produktkommunikation für konkrete Verkaufssituationen.

Was du mitbringst

  • Erfahrung: Du hast mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung im Marketing, idealerweise im B2B-Umfeld eines Startups, Scale-ups oder Technologieunternehmens. Du hast Kampagnen eigenständig umgesetzt und idealerweise bereits einen Produktlaunch begleitet.

  • Breites Marketing-Know-how: Du kennst dich mit digitalen Marketingkanälen aus und hast praktische Erfahrung mit SEO, SEA, Content Marketing und Kampagnenmanagement. Du musst nicht alles perfekt beherrschen, weißt aber, wie du die richtigen Maßnahmen priorisierst und umsetzt.

  • Zahlenverständnis: Du setzt dir messbare Ziele und weißt, wie du sie nachhältst. Google Analytics, CRM-Software und Performance-Kennzahlen gehören zu deinem Arbeitsalltag. Du nutzt Daten, um Marketingmaßnahmen kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

  • Interesse für Technologie: Du interessierst dich für komplexe Technologien und hast Lust, tief in die Robotik einzutauchen. Du kannst technische Zusammenhänge verstehen und so vermitteln, dass sie auch für Menschen außerhalb der Entwicklung greifbar werden.

  • Kommunikation & Content: Aus einem technischen Gespräch mit einem Engineer machst du eine Case Study, Website-Copy oder einen Social-Media-Beitrag, der die richtige Zielgruppe erreicht.

  • Arbeitsweise: Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, arbeitest eigenständig und pragmatisch und hast Freude daran, neue Strukturen mit aufzubauen. Du wechselst zwischen Planung und Umsetzung, ohne eines von beidem aus dem Blick zu verlieren.

  • Sprachen: Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher.

Benefits

  • Marketing von Grund auf: Es gibt kein fertiges Playbook und keine Altlasten. Du gestaltest gemeinsam mit unserem Marketingteam, wie Cell Labs am Markt sichtbar wird, und siehst die Wirkung deiner Arbeit direkt.

  • Alles unter einem Dach: Büro, Werkstatt und Teststände liegen im selben Gebäude in Kreuzberg. Wenn du eine Story für eine Case Study brauchst oder den Roboter in Aktion sehen willst, ist der Engineer ein paar Schritte entfernt, kein Ticket.

  • Room to Fail & Grow: Bezahlte Lernzeit mit persönlichem Budget für Kurse, Marketing-Konferenzen und die Tools, die du brauchst. Du bekommst Raum, Neues auszuprobieren, und bringst ein Produkt an den Markt, das bisher kaum jemand gesehen hat.

  • Benefits: Ein Leistungspaket, das du dir selbst zusammenstellst und das Mobilität, Gesundheit, Ernährung oder Fitness abdeckt. Dazu gibt’s einen zusätzlichen bezahlten freien Tag im Jahr für ehrenamtliches Engagement oder ein Projekt, das dir am Herzen liegt.

Bewerbung

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Zeilen zu einer Marketingkampagne oder einem Projekt, das du eigenständig umgesetzt hast. Was war das Ziel, was hast du getan und was kam dabei heraus? Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

Der Prozess: Intro Call, Deep Dive in deine bisherige Arbeit, Besuch bei uns mit einer kleinen Case Study, Angebot.

Wir bauen Roboter für alle, deshalb wollen wir ein Team, das das abbildet. Wir stellen nach Fähigkeiten ein und freuen uns ausdrücklich über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die in Marketing und Tech unterrepräsentiert sind. Wenn du nicht jeden Punkt erfüllst, aber denkst, das ist dein Job: bewirb dich.

jobs.title: Quantum Dot Process & Characterisation Engineer- Post-Growth Processing (Master)
jobs.description:
Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors. 

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀

Role overview

We are looking for a Process & Characterisation Engineer to prepare and validate GaAs/AlGaAs samples containing InAs quantum dots (QDs) through the first steps of our single-photon source fabrication flow.

The role combines hands-on cleanroom processing – chemical treatment, PECVD deposition and high-temperature annealing – with optical characterisation of the QDs before and after each step. The data you produce decides whether a sample is ready to move forward, and how the process recipes should be adjusted.

You will start by running an established, well-documented procedure with rigour and consistency. As you build expertise, the role is designed to grow: within your first year, you will contribute to optimising the process, automating the measurement setups and taking ownership of sample validation for these steps, working closely with both the Production and R&D teams.

Sample preparation & processing (from day one)

  • Run the established step-by-step procedure for preparing GaAs/AlGaAs samples with InAs quantum dots.
  • Carry out the cleanroom fabrication steps: chemical surface treatment, PECVD deposition and high-temperature annealing.
  • Follow recipes and operating procedures precisely, and flag any deviation, drift or anomaly as soon as it appears.
  • Contribute to a safe, disciplined and efficient cleanroom environment.

Optical characterisation & validation

  • Measure QD optical properties before and after processing, using photoluminescence and white-field imaging, including at cryogenic temperature.
  • Compare pre- and post-processing results against acceptance criteria to decide whether each sample can be released to the next fabrication steps.
  • Adjust process recipes based on measurement results, within defined process windows.

Data, reporting & traceability

  • Analyse measurement data using Python and report results clearly and regularly to the Production and R&D teams.
  • Maintain the sample database so that every sample’s processing history and measurements are fully traceable.
  • Keep process documentation and procedures up to date.

Growing your scope (within the first year)

  • Contribute to the automation and optimisation of the optical measurement setups and data-acquisition pipeline.
  • Propose, design and test improvements to the fabrication steps, using experimental data and the scientific literature.
  • Take ownership of sample validation for these steps, including defining checks and acceptance criteria.
  • Contribute to the development and qualification of new or additional process steps, together with the R&D team.

Requirements

Required qualifications & experience

  • Master’s degree (Bac+5) in Materials Science, Semiconductor Physics, Optics, Micro/Nanofabrication or a related field.
  • Solid foundations in semiconductor physics, particularly III-V materials.
  • Solid foundations in optics and in semiconductor fabrication processes.
  • Fluency in Python for data analysis.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a rigorous approach to experimental work.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to investigate technical problems using experimental data and scientific literature.
  • Clear documentation and communication skills.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken.

Preferred qualifications

  • Hands-on cleanroom experience, ideally in III-V device fabrication: wet and dry etching, PECVD deposition, thermal processing.

If you are passionate about semiconductor fabrication and quantum technologies, we would love to hear from you, even if you don’t tick every box.

jobs.title: Photonics Packaging & Cryogenic Integration R&D Engineer
jobs.description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry.
Its offerings include a very energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers.
Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components.
Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.
Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Description of the Team/Project

We are looking for a Photonics Packaging & Cryogenic Integration Engineer to contribute to the development and industrialization of our photonic quantum systems.

You will work on the integration of single-photon sources, photonic integrated circuits and optical/electromechanical assemblies, with a strong focus on miniaturization, automation and operation under cryogenic conditions.

This is a highly hands-on role at the intersection of photonics, electronics, mechanics, automation and experimental physics.

You will contribute across the full development cycle: design, prototyping, assembly, testing, optimization and transfer toward industrial-scale production.

Your Key Responsibilities: 

    • Design and develop packaging and integration solutions for photonic and quantum devices.
    • Integrate single-photon sources, photonic integrated circuits and optical components into complete systems.
    • Develop and optimize optical coupling strategies, including fiber coupling and direct chip-to-chip integration.
    • Design, build and assemble precision positioning and alignment systems, including nano-positioning stages and multi-axis platforms.
    • Develop experimental setups operating under cryogenic conditions, typically in the 2–4 K range.
    • Design mechanical parts and assemblies using CAD tools.
    • Contribute to electronics development, including PCB design, instrumentation and control systems.
    • Automate alignment, test and characterization processes using Python, C++, Rust or similar programming languages.
    • Work with microcontrollers, FPGA-based systems or other hardware-control architectures when relevant.
    • Build, test and iterate rapidly on prototypes, including using 3D printing and other rapid prototyping techniques.
    • Perform test and measurement activities to characterize system performance and identify failure modes.
    • Contribute feedback to the design of photonic chips and single-photon sources based on integration and testing results.
    • Support the transition from laboratory prototypes to repeatable and scalable manufacturing processes.
    • Document designs, experiments, procedures and lessons learned, and actively share knowledge within the team.

Requirements

What we're looking for: 

You should ideally bring:

  • A PhD in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, applied physics, condensed matter physics, solid-state physics, optics, photonics or a related field.
  • Strong hands-on experience building and testing scientific or high-precision equipment.
  • Experience with photonics, optomechanics, semiconductor devices, cryogenics or precision engineering.
  • Familiarity with optical alignment, fiber coupling and/or photonic packaging.
  • Experience with mechanical design and CAD tools.
  • Good understanding of electronics, instrumentation and test equipment.
  • Programming skills in Python, C++, Rust or similar languages for automation and hardware control.
  • Experience working with multidisciplinary systems combining optics, mechanics, electronics and software.
  • Strong experimental problem-solving skills and the ability to iterate quickly from concept to prototype.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to produce clear technical documentation and collaborate in an international environment.

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be particularly valuable:

  • Cryogenic systems and experiments at very low temperatures.
  • Photonic or optoelectronic packaging.
  • Chip bonding, indium bump bonding or related micro-assembly techniques.
  • Pick-and-place systems or automated precision assembly.
  • Nano-positioning and multi-axis motion control systems.
  • Robotics or computer vision.
  • FPGA or microcontroller development.
  • PCB design using KiCad or similar tools.
  • Finite-element simulation using tools such as ANSYS or COMSOL.
  • Semiconductor or quantum photonics environments.

More than a specific academic background, we are looking for someone who enjoys building complex scientific systems and solving problems directly at the hardware level.

Benefits

  • Company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • A hybrid work model (3-4 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris or 1 to 2 days remotely)

jobs.title: Product Owner WIFI, RF & Embedded Systems
jobs.description:
Chez Exotec, nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. A travers le monde, nos solutions révolutionnent la façon dont nos client·e·s délivrent leurs produits aux personnes consommatrices finales. Nous contribuons au succès des plus grandes marques du commerce et de l’industrie, tout en améliorant les conditions de travail de leurs salarié·e·s.

Par l’alliance de l’intelligence artificielle et d’un hardware performant, nos robots sont désormais déployés dans le monde entier et leur succès a fait de nous la première licorne industrielle française.

Rejoindre Exotec, c’est l’opportunité de donner du sens à vos compétences. Grandissez avec nos ExoPeople dans le monde entier pour faire de vos idées, des réalités.

La révolution robotique portée par Exotec ne fait que commencer, vous en êtes ?

Au sein de l'équipe Product Management ASRS, le Product Owner Connectivity est responsable de la stratégie produit, du développement, de la performance et de la fiabilité des solutions de connectivité déployées sur une flotte mondiale de plus de 12 000 robots autonomes.

Le Product Owner Connectivity pilote l'ensemble des solutions de communication sans fil utilisées au sein des systèmes robotiques et équipements associés. Il garantit leur performance, leur robustesse, leur évolutivité et leur conformité aux exigences opérationnelles et de sécurité.

À l'interface entre les équipes Software, Electrical, Safety, Architecture, Validation et Opérations, il définit la roadmap produit et assure la livraison de solutions de connectivité répondant aux besoins actuels et futurs de l'entreprise.

Missions :

Solutions de connectivité

  • Pilotage du développement et de l'évolution du nouveau module WiFi propriétaire développé en interne.
  • Pilotage des organes de sécurité utilisant des technologies RF.
  • Responsabilité des équipements électriques intégrant ces technologies de communication.
  • Définition et suivi de la stratégie de connectivité des systèmes robotiques.

Gestion produit

  • Construire et maintenir la roadmap produit Connectivity.
  • Prioriser les évolutions fonctionnelles et techniques en fonction des enjeux business et opérationnels.
  • Recueillir et challenger les besoins des parties prenantes internes.
  • Piloter les arbitrages entre performance, coût, fiabilité et délais.

Performance & fiabilité

  • Assurer la disponibilité et la robustesse des communications sans fil à grande échelle.
  • Analyser les incidents terrain et définir les plans d'amélioration continue.
  • Suivre les indicateurs de performance et de qualité des solutions déployées.
  • Garantir la scalabilité des solutions pour accompagner la croissance de la flotte.

Coordination technique

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Embedded Software, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering et Safety.
  • Contribuer aux choix d'architecture des futures générations de produits.
  • Assurer la cohérence des solutions développées avec la stratégie technologique globale.

Profil

  • 8 à 10 ans d'expérience dans le développement de produits ou systèmes technologiques complexes, idéalement dans un environnement industriel.
  • Solides connaissances en connectivité sans fil (WiFi 5 GHz / 6 GHz, technologies RF, couverture, roaming et performance réseau).
  • Bonne compréhension des systèmes embarqués, de leurs architectures logicielles et des contraintes associées (temps réel, cybersécurité, sécurité fonctionnelle).
  • Connaissance des architectures électriques et systèmes industriels, avec la capacité à collaborer efficacement avec des experts hardware, software et systèmes.
  • Expérience du pilotage de sujets techniques complexes et de la coordination d'équipes multidisciplinaires.
  • Excellentes capacités d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes, de communication et d'influence.
  • Fort intérêt pour l'innovation technologique, l'amélioration continue et les environnements industriels exigeants.

Benefits

  • Couverture mutuelle et prévoyance santé compétitive
  • Politique famille avantageuse
  • Programme de mobilité interne et internationale
  • Nombreuses opportunités de formation et de développement

Chez Exotec, nous garantissons l’égalité des chances dans notre processus de recrutement. L’ensemble des candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’âge, du genre, de l’origine, de la religion, de la couleur de peau, de la nationalité, du sexe, du handicap, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de toute autre distinction protégée par la loi.

Nous mettons en place un environnement de travail inclusif et respectueux de toutes les différences.
En rejoignant le Pacte Parité, Exotec s’engage pour un écosystème French Tech plus paritaire.

Pour postuler, veuillez envoyer votre CV. Seul·e·s les candidat·e·s présélectionné·e·s seront contacté·e·s pour les prochaines étapes du processus de recrutement. Au plaisir de recevoir votre candidature ! Si vous postulez à un poste en Europe, veuillez consulter notre politique de confidentialité pour plus de détails.

jobs.title: Account Development Representative - France
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained — both on the job and through formal programs led by a world-class Sales team — to take on your next role as a closing Account Executive.

On a daily basis, you will build and work a portfolio of target accounts for our EMEA business in France: researching each account for commercial signal, prioritising which contacts to approach and in what order, and running a connected, multi-touch outbound motion that generates qualified pipeline rather than one-off meetings.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CET. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: your efforts will result in real-world impact — helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: if you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You're excited by AI: you'll use cutting-edge AI tools every day and sell some of the most advanced AI in the physical operations space.
  • You think several moves ahead: you'd rather build a real relationship across an account than force a single contact to a decision they're not ready to make.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: one day you'll be researching a transport operator, the next a food distribution centre. Our best reps dig into the businesses they support to make a sharper case for why Samsara matters to them specifically.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: in this role you will get hung up on and told no. You need the resilience to prepare, call again, and adjust.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go further than you have before.

In this role, you will: 

  • Research target accounts before outreach — pulling commercial signal out of public information (financials, news, hiring activity, compliance or safety pressure) to build a specific, defensible point of view on where Samsara adds value.
  • Build and prioritise an account-level contact plan, identifying who to approach first across a range of stakeholders (e.g. MD, Operations/Transport Manager, Compliance/H&S, Finance) and being able to justify that choice.
  • Run a connected, multi-touch outbound motion across phone, email and LinkedIn — using early conversations to gather information and multi-thread the account, not just to book a meeting at any cost.
  • Write personalised, researched outreach (including cold emails) that carries a specific point of view into every call, rather than working from a generic script.
  • Read what a contact gives you on the call and adapt in real time — including recognising when the right move is to gather information and position a follow-up with someone else, rather than push for a meeting the contact can't actually commit to.
  • Keep meticulous account and contact records in Salesforce.
  • Become a product expert and represent the Samsara brand at trade shows and events.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1–3 years professional experience, ideally in customer-facing roles
  • 6–12 months  experience in a sales or equivalent target driven role 
  • Highly motivated and committed, with a strong desire to work in target-driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding targets in previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Curious, and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French
  • AI literacy and ability to showcase examples of leveraging AI in your work

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Comfort turning unstructured information (an annual report, a website, a news article) into a clear commercial argument
  • Experience multi-threading or navigating multiple stakeholders within a single sale
  • A genuine willingness to prepare — to research and write — before a call, rather than relying on improvising well under pressure
  • Experience in closing-sales roles or similar target driven environment 
  • A proven track record of achievement beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space.

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility. With emphasis on continued professional development, training doesn't stop after onboarding — we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and competitors, develop hard skills, and work with mentors to progress through three levels:

  • ADR I — focus on inbound leads: a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with interested prospects. Learning opportunities include call sessions with senior Sales team members, tool training (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, and objection handling.
  • ADR II — work on top-of-funnel movement, creating high-quality sales engagements, and supporting Account Executives. Enrolled in specialised training including professional writing, persona-based messaging, cold calling 2.0, and AE collaboration.
  • ADR III — work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers. Partner on large accounts, implement territory plans, join weekly strategy meetings, and schedule/attend customer demos, alongside a mentorship program ahead of an AE interview.

Please submit an English CV with your application.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained — both on the job and through formal programs led by a world-class Sales team — to take on your next role as a closing Account Executive.

On a daily basis, you will build and work a portfolio of target accounts for our EMEA business in France: researching each account for commercial signal, prioritising which contacts to approach and in what order, and running a connected, multi-touch outbound motion that generates qualified pipeline rather than one-off meetings.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CET. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: your efforts will result in real-world impact — helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: if you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You're excited by AI: you'll use cutting-edge AI tools every day and sell some of the most advanced AI in the physical operations space.
  • You think several moves ahead: you'd rather build a real relationship across an account than force a single contact to a decision they're not ready to make.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: one day you'll be researching a transport operator, the next a food distribution centre. Our best reps dig into the businesses they support to make a sharper case for why Samsara matters to them specifically.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: in this role you will get hung up on and told no. You need the resilience to prepare, call again, and adjust.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go further than you have before.

In this role, you will: 

  • Research target accounts before outreach — pulling commercial signal out of public information (financials, news, hiring activity, compliance or safety pressure) to build a specific, defensible point of view on where Samsara adds value.
  • Build and prioritise an account-level contact plan, identifying who to approach first across a range of stakeholders (e.g. MD, Operations/Transport Manager, Compliance/H&S, Finance) and being able to justify that choice.
  • Run a connected, multi-touch outbound motion across phone, email and LinkedIn — using early conversations to gather information and multi-thread the account, not just to book a meeting at any cost.
  • Write personalised, researched outreach (including cold emails) that carries a specific point of view into every call, rather than working from a generic script.
  • Read what a contact gives you on the call and adapt in real time — including recognising when the right move is to gather information and position a follow-up with someone else, rather than push for a meeting the contact can't actually commit to.
  • Keep meticulous account and contact records in Salesforce.
  • Become a product expert and represent the Samsara brand at trade shows and events.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1–3 years professional experience, ideally in customer-facing roles
  • 6–12 months  experience in a sales or equivalent target driven role 
  • Highly motivated and committed, with a strong desire to work in target-driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding targets in previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Curious, and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French
  • AI literacy and ability to showcase examples of leveraging AI in your work

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Comfort turning unstructured information (an annual report, a website, a news article) into a clear commercial argument
  • Experience multi-threading or navigating multiple stakeholders within a single sale
  • A genuine willingness to prepare — to research and write — before a call, rather than relying on improvising well under pressure
  • Experience in closing-sales roles or similar target driven environment 
  • A proven track record of achievement beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space.

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility. With emphasis on continued professional development, training doesn't stop after onboarding — we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and competitors, develop hard skills, and work with mentors to progress through three levels:

  • ADR I — focus on inbound leads: a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with interested prospects. Learning opportunities include call sessions with senior Sales team members, tool training (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, and objection handling.
  • ADR II — work on top-of-funnel movement, creating high-quality sales engagements, and supporting Account Executives. Enrolled in specialised training including professional writing, persona-based messaging, cold calling 2.0, and AE collaboration.
  • ADR III — work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers. Partner on large accounts, implement territory plans, join weekly strategy meetings, and schedule/attend customer demos, alongside a mentorship program ahead of an AE interview.

Please submit an English CV with your application.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. jobs.title: CFO (Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung)
jobs.description:
Das Universitäre Zentrum für Zahnmedizin Basel (UZB) vereint Patientenbehandlung, akademische Lehre und Forschung unter einem Dach. Mit rund 300 Mitarbeitenden, rund 100'000 Behandlungen pro Jahr und einem Umsatz von ca. CHF 40 Mio. erbringt das UZB seine Leistungen unter anderem auf Basis von Leistungsaufträgen mit der Universität Basel und dem Kanton Basel-Stadt. Wir suchen eine oder einen CFO mit überzeugenden betriebswirtschaftlichen und finanziellen Kenntnissen. Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung ist neben dem Finanzwissen auch unternehmerisches Denken und Handeln gefragt, um das Unternehmen gesamtheitlich zu steuern und weiterzuentwickeln.

Ihre Verantwortung

  • Sie verantworten die finanzielle Führung des UZB – von der Budget-, Liquiditäts- und Finanzplanung über das Rechnungswesen und die Rechnungslegung nach Swiss GAAP FER bis hin zum Controlling – und stellen ein aussagekräftiges, stufengerechtes Reporting an unsere Leitungserbringer, die Geschäftsleitung und den Verwaltungsrat sicher.

  • Sie sichern die Finanzierung und Liquidität, entwickeln das Risikomanagement und das interne Kontrollsystem weiter und sind Ansprechperson für den Prüfungsausschuss des Verwaltungsrats und die Revisionsstelle.

  • Sie führen und entwickeln die Bereiche Finanzen (rund 10 Mitarbeitende), IT (3), Technischer Dienst (3) und Einkauf mit vier direkt unterstellten Führungspersonen und fördern die Zusammenarbeit über Fachgrenzen hinweg.

  • Sie bringen die Digitalisierung und Weiterentwicklung von Abläufen und Systemen voran und entscheiden bei der laufenden Evaluation einer neuen ERP-Lösung massgeblich mit.

  • Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung tragen Sie auch die gesamtunternehmerische Verantwortung mit und bringen sich in Fragen der Unternehmensentwicklung aktiv ein.

  • Sie beraten die CEO und die Geschäftsleitung als Sparringpartner in allen betriebswirtschaftlichen Fragen und erarbeiten Business Cases für neue Angebote und Projekte.

  • Sie schaffen Entscheidungsgrundlagen für den Dialog mit internen und externen Anspruchsgruppen in einem öffentlich-rechtlich geprägten Umfeld und pflegen den Kontakt zu den relevanten Stakeholdern.

Ihr beruflicher Hintergrund

  • Sie verfügen über substanzielles Know-how in Finanzen und Controlling sowie über Erfahrung in einer verantwortlichen Finanzführungsfunktion.

  • Sie haben einen (Fach-) Hochschulstudium in Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen oder sind Expertin bzw. Experte in Rechnungslegung und Controlling; Erfahrung mit Swiss GAAP FER und SAP ist von Vorteil.

  • Sie haben Führungserfahrung, sind es gewohnt bei Entscheidungsprozessen mitzuwirken und anschliessend die Entscheidungen in ihrem Verantwortungsbereich konsequent umzusetzen. Sie kommunizieren differenziert und transparent, arbeiten pragmatisch und verbinden finanzielle Sorgfalt mit Offenheit für neue Lösungen.

  • Sie verfügen über stilsichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Sie interessieren sich für Digitalisierung und einen verantwortungsvollen Umgang mit Daten und neuen Technologien.

  • Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen oder in einer öffentlich-rechtlichen Organisation sind willkommen, doch keine Voraussetzung.

Was die Aufgabe auszeichnet

Das UZB ist eine dynamische Institution: 2016 gegründet und seit 2021 um rund 30 % gewachsen. Unsere Strukturen, Prozesse und Systeme lassen sich aktiv mitprägen. Sie verbinden eine finanzielle Schlüsselrolle mit der Möglichkeit, die Weiterentwicklung einer Unternehmung mit gesellschaftlichem Auftrag aus Geschäftsleitungsperspektive mitzugestalten. Die Position verlangt Nähe zum Tagesgeschäft ebenso wie einen verlässlichen Blick auf das Ganze.

jobs.title: Agent Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Belmont Lavan is hiring an Agent Security Engineer to secure autonomous AI agents before and after they reach production. Agents now call tools, hold credentials and act on live systems, so they need the controls we already expect for people and services: identity, least-privilege access, monitoring and testing.

You will sit between AI engineering and security. You will design the guardrails, attack the systems yourself, and build the governance controls that let the business deploy agents with confidence.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in security engineering (AppSec, cloud security, IAM or offensive security), with at least 1 year securing LLM or agent-based systems
  • Hands-on knowledge of LLM attack techniques: prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration via tools, RAG poisoning
  • Experience designing identity and access controls: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, token exchange, workload identity, secrets management
  • Working knowledge of agent frameworks and protocols such as LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI or Model Context Protocol (MCP)
  • Strong coding skills in Python, plus one of Go, TypeScript or Rust
  • Cloud security on AWS, Azure or GCP, including logging, detection and policy-as-code (e.g. OPA / Cedar)
  • Ability to explain AI risk clearly to engineers, risk teams and executives

jobs.title: Customer Care Analyst & Ops - CDI
jobs.description:
Green-Got est une institution financière française qui permet à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance.

Nous construisons l'infrastructure financière du monde de demain.

Depuis janvier 2026, Green-Got est un Établissement de Paiement agréé par l'ACPR, supervisé par la Banque de France. Une reconnaissance qui nous place au niveau des acteurs réglementés de premier plan, et qui change en profondeur ce que nous construisons, et comment.

Green-Got propose :

  • Un compte de paiement associé à une carte pour payer et être payé au quotidien.
  • Une gamme de placements financiers performants pour investir dans les entreprises de la transition.

L'expérience membre est au cœur de ce modèle. C'est le socle sur lequel repose la confiance que nos membres nous accordent, et que l'équipe Customer Care entretient chaque jour.

Green-Got en chiffres :

  • 100 M€ de transactions traitées chaque mois ;
  • 2,3 Md€ de transactions sécurisées depuis notre lancement ;
  • 2 M€ de dons reversés à des projets de transition ;
  • 4,8/5 sur Trustpilot ;
  • 5 % de notre chiffre d'affaires pour soutenir directement des projets de terrain, en finançant directement la Fondation Green-Got.

Le contexte :

📍 Locaux à Paris + télétravail, ouvert au full remote depuis ton pays de résidence ;
📄 CDI : contrat de 39h /semaine ;
💶 28–32K € selon profil ;
🗓 Prise de poste : au plus tôt.

Chez Green-Got, le Customer Care est la voix de nos membres en interne, et la voix de Green-Got auprès d'eux, un rôle stratégique dans une institution financière qui grandit vite et qui doit tenir ses promesses 7 jours sur 7.

Nos membres ont changé de dimension avec nous : Compte Premium, PER, compte commun, offre indépendant. Chaque nouveau produit génère de nouvelles questions, de nouvelles situations, de nouveaux défis. L'ouverture prochaine des services BtoB va encore élargir le périmètre.

Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui aime comprendre, qui sait garder son calme sous pression, et qui considère chaque échange comme une opportunité d'améliorer le produit, pas juste de fermer un ticket.

Tu es à l'aise avec les gens et rigoureux sur le fond. Les deux à la fois.

Vos missions

Tes missions :

Membre de l'équipe Customer Care, tu es le point de relais central entre nos membres et toutes les équipes de Green-Got : produit, tech, compliance, marketing, impact. Ton périmètre est vivant : il évolue avec nos lancements, nos besoins, et la trajectoire de Green-Got.

Ta capacité à t'adapter, à prioriser et à garder un haut niveau de qualité dans tous les contextes est ce qui nous permettra de grandir sereinement.

FRONT - Relation membre 50 %

  • Premier point de contact : tu réponds à nos membres sur tous nos canaux, chat (90 %), email (8 %), téléphone (2 %), avec clarté, empathie et dans les délais.
  • Expertise produit : tu connais Green-Got sur le bout des doigts. Tu accompagnes nos membres sur leurs comptes, leurs transactions, leurs questions, et tu trouves la bonne réponse après investigation.
  • Gestion des nouvelles situations : tu identifies, qualifies et résous les cas inédits. Tu es garant de la qualité du premier contact.

RUN - Support opérationnel 35 %

  • Voix des membres en interne : tu collectes, structures et remontes les besoins, frustrations et suggestions aux équipes produit, tech, marketing.
  • Amélioration continue : tu optimises les process existants, challenges les workflows, et maintiens notre documentation (FAQ, process) à jour à chaque évolution produit.
  • Suivi des incidents : tu identifies les bugs, les remontes aux équipes concernées et en assures le suivi jusqu'à résolution.
  • Recette fonctionnelle : tu participes aux phases de test des nouvelles fonctionnalités avant mise en production.

BUILD - Gestion de projet 15 %

  • Initiative et ownership : tu identifies des leviers d'amélioration de l'expérience membre, tu définis des indicateurs, proposes et mets en œuvre des actions concrètes.
  • Pilotage : tu mets en place les outils et routines nécessaires au suivi de tes projets et en garantis le résultat.

Vos compétences

L'empathie, la rigueur dans l'exécution et la capacité à rester serein quand ça s'accélère sont pour toi des réflexes naturels. Tu comprends que la qualité du service est un engagement, pas une intention. Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui en est convaincu.

Chez Green-Got, nous sommes curieux, exigeants, collectifs, et nous allons vite.

  • Sens du service : tu sais que derrière chaque ticket, il y a une personne. Tu ne fermes pas un ticket, tu résous un problème.
  • Rigueur et organisation : tu priorises, tu documentes, tu assures un suivi sans failles.
  • Aisance rédactionnelle : ton orthographe est irréprochable, tu adaptes le ton à chaque interlocuteur. La précision est ta signature.
  • Curiosité analytique : tu aimes comprendre pourquoi une situation se produit, pas juste la résoudre. Tu identifies les patterns et tu les remontes.
  • Gestion du stress : tu gardes ton calme quand la situation l'exige. La pression ne dégrade pas ta qualité.
  • Anglais opérationnel : tu lis, tu réponds, tu échanges sans chercher tes mots. Nous avons des membres non francophones et nous en aurons davantage.
  • Sensibilité à l'impact : la transition environnementale a une réelle importance pour toi. Tu comprends les enjeux et tu portes la mission de Green-Got avec sincérité.
  • Appétence pour les outils numériques : Intercom, Notion, Slack, Aircall, et une vraie curiosité pour l'IA et l'automatisation appliquées au service client.
  • Formation : BTS, IUT, école de commerce, IAE ou toute formation en lien avec la relation client. Une première expérience en care ou service client est un vrai plus.

Avantages

Green-Got entre dans une nouvelle phase. Avec l'agrément ACPR, nous construisons une expérience membre de premier plan, avec les personnes qui nous rejoignent maintenant.

Le service client de demain ne se construit uniquement avec des scripts et des macros. Il se construit avec des personnes qui comprennent le produit, les membres, et l'enjeu de chaque interaction.

  • Un rôle avec de l'impact réel : dans un secteur en pleine transformation, au contact direct de nos membres chaque jour.
  • De vraies responsabilités : tu n'exécutes pas, tu contribues. Tes remontées terrain façonnent le produit.
  • Apprentissage : aux côtés d'une équipe qui transmet, dans un environnement réglementaire de premier plan.
  • Évolution : les profils les plus engagés grandissent avec nous et prennent des responsabilités clés.
  • Flexibilité : remote possible depuis chez toi et partout en Europe.
  • Équipe : ambitieuse, exigeante, déterminée, et qui passe de bons moments ensemble.

Le package :

  • CDI remote ou Paris.
  • Rémunération : 28 - 32k, selon profil.
  • BSPCE.
  • Mutuelle santé Alan.
  • Une journée d’équipe tous les semestres.

Déroulement des entretiens :

  • Envoie-nous ton CV et tout autre élément qui nous aide à jauger tes compétences et ta motivation.
  • Call rapide pour faire connaissance. Si ça matche, on t’envoie un Business Case à préparer.
  • Entretien en visio avec Vincent (Customer Care Manager) pour analyser le Business Case et te tester / te connaitre.
  • Échange avec un ou plusieurs membres de l’équipe pour le fit culturel.
  • Entretien avec Adèle (Head of Operations).
  • Entretien avec Andréa (CEO).

Nous avons hâte de te rencontrer !

At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

🦾 Our Offer Operations team

Joko helps millions of users earn cashback automatically, whether they shop online through affiliate links, activate coupons, or pay in-store with their linked bank card. Behind each of these experiences, there's an operational engine that needs to work flawlessly: transactions must be tracked, cashback must be caught, offers must be reliable, and merchants must perform as expected. When this engine breaks, users don't get paid — and trust erodes fast.

Offer Operations owns that engine. The team's mission is to guarantee the reliability and continuous improvement of Joko's core monetization mechanics — across affiliate tracking, coupons, card-linked bank integrations, gift cards, and merchant performance. It's a technical, data-heavy, high-stakes scope that sits right at the heart of what makes Joko's product work.

🎯 What you will do

As an Operations Manager, your main mission is to own one of the processes that decides whether millions of Joko users actually get the cashback they're owed. You'll report to David Le Pahun, our Offer Operations Lead. The role blends four things: analysing data, designing how the process should work, solving problems with AI, technologies or in the last resort outsourcing, and managing projects.

  • Analyse data. You'll build the dashboards that tell you — and everyone else — whether your part of the system is healthy: how many transactions are being correctly tracked and rewarded, what's silently breaking down, whether user experience is suffering.

  • Design the process. You decide how merchants get set up on our platform: their cashback rate, which purchases qualify, how we connect to their systems. A lot of this doesn't have a playbook yet — you'll be writing a good chunk of it as you go.

  • Solve problems with technology. A merchant might be showing users a coupon that doesn't actually pay out. A batch of card purchases might not match cleanly to any merchant we track. You'll dig into why, then fix it choosing the right solution for it: automating it with AI, improving one of our internal tools (built on Retool) and if a human is required, you'll build the right playbook to outsource it.

  • Manage outsourced resources. You'll manage the outsourced team members who help you operate at scale — briefing them, training them, checking their work is actually good — while juggling several of these issues at once and deciding what matters most.

  • Partner cross-functionally. With Product & Engineering when the fix is structural, and with the commercial team when it's really about a merchant relationship.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: around 2–5 years of experience, ideally with exposure to Operations, Product, or a technical/data-driven environment.

  • AI-native: you genuinely believe in what AI can do, and you already use it as part of how you work — not as a buzzword, but as a real way to automate the repetitive parts of your job and move faster on the rest.

  • Ops mindset: you think in systems — monitoring → detection → investigation → resolution → prevention. You instinctively look for what can break and build safeguards so it doesn't happen again.

  • Tech acumen: you're comfortable in a technical environment — tracking, APIs, integrations — and can hold your own in a conversation with Engineering.

  • Education: Top-tier engineering or business school background. International experience and a double degree are a clear plus.

  • Languages: fluent in written and spoken English. Mastering French is not required.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:
